name: puzzle
scope: Original full workload, fresh processes, default V8 tiering; setup excluded and final predicate included.

rust.name: puzzle
rust.setup_excluded: Scheme-format datum reading and count/size parsing; Wasm compilation/instantiation/startup; once-per-process board and 13 independent piece-buffer allocation before Instant. Original Scheme creates its persistent global vectors before run-benchmark.
rust.predicate_boundary: Every reset, board/piece initialization, fixed ordered orientation definition, fitting/placing/removing, recursive search and trial-counter update, all 1000 repetitions, then supplied expected equality before report/start.elapsed. Result/CSV formatting follows clock capture.
rust.timed: All 1000 complete puzzle searches, including per-iteration reset; final supplied scalar equality before stop clock. Original common.scm also calls its ok? predicate before ending the clock.

correctness.predicate: The full search returns trial-counter 2005 and equals supplied expected datum; original Scheme returns false on search failure, while Rust asserts successful fit/search.
correctness.small: Actual Node/Wasm and unchanged original Chez pass count1/size511/result2005 and reject wrong999. This reduces repeat count while retaining the fixed puzzle geometry.
correctness.complete_payload: Native test checks all512 board positions filled, all four piece counts zero and repeated reset/search. No complete-board dump from the actual Wasm artifact is claimed.

rust.representation: Rust Vec<bool> stores unpacked one-byte booleans in linear memory; 13 separately owned 512-element piece buffers. Classes/maxima/counts use Wasm32 usize arrays. Scheme uses persistent generic vectors and its booleans/integers in GC storage.
rust.ownership: One Puzzle owns/reuses board, piece templates and counters for the whole process. Recursive fitting/search calls borrow that state; backtracking restores occupied cells/counts before the next orientation. No per-search-call owned graph allocation or shared-cell aliasing is introduced. Collection and frame/call costs differ from Scheme.
rust.opacity: black_box(size) at each run and black_box(returned trial count) before storing final result. No complete-board validation or additional per-search opacity inside timing.
rust.source_semantics: Fixed 512-element storage and canonical size511, orientation order, starting placement73 and recursive trial(next) before next==0 are preserved. The source local nonescaping call/cc early success escape becomes an ordinary Boolean return; this executable does not implement general continuations. Nonnegative Wasm32 usize inputs and bounds differ from Scheme outside the checked canonical geometry; count0 handling differs.

inspection.notes: Frozen artifact retains recursive trial, fitting and placement functions, ordered backtracking state changes and main search call. This is a source/function-retention inspection, not a complete-board payload audit or a new performance observation.
